faq_a1: This app connects people with local home chefs offering single or limited dishes daily. You can browse meals, chat with chefs, and order directly.
faq_q2: Is this a restaurant or delivery service?
faq_a2: No, this app is a marketplace. Home chefs post their meals, and you contact them to reserve, pay, and pick up.
faq_q3: How do I pay for a meal?
faq_a3: You can pay with cash during pickup or use card in the app. Card payments include a small 3% service fee.
faq_q4: Why is card payment more expensive?
faq_a4: The extra cost covers processing fees so the chefs still receive their full price.
faq_a5: Refunds depend on the chef's personal policy. Always contact them in advance if you can’t pick up your meal.
faq_q6: How do I know if a dish is available?
faq_a6: Each dish is limited. After tapping "Confirm Order", the chef will confirm availability via chat.
faq_q7: Can I schedule a pickup time?
faq_a7: Yes, discuss pickup time directly in the chat with the chef.
faq_q8: What if the chef doesn’t respond?
faq_a8: You can cancel and try another dish or report the issue from their profile.
faq_q9: How do I know if a chef is reliable?
faq_a9: Each chef has a profile with ratings, recent meals, dietary tags, and hygiene badges (if verified).
faq_a10: Yes, go to the chef’s profile and tap "Report".
faq_q11: Can I filter meals by my preferences?
faq_a11: Yes, go to Profile → Preferences to set dietary needs and allergy tags.
faq_q12: Will I be warned if a dish has allergens?
faq_a12: Yes. If a chef tags their meals with allergens, you’ll be warned before confirming your order.
faq_a13: Only what’s needed: email, location (for nearby meals), and your selected preferences.
faq_q14: How can I delete my account?
faq_a14: Go to Profile → Personal Data → Delete Account to remove your data permanently.
faq_a15: No. Your card details are processed securely through our payment provider and never stored by us.
faq_a16: Email support@odlua.com or go to Profile → Contact Support.

tos_allowed_bullet2: Non-commercial and occasional food exchange between neighbors.
tos_allowed_summary: Free sharing/donating of homemade food and occasional exchanges between neighbors.
tos_prohibited_bullet1: Selling food or requesting any form of payment or compensation.

tos_prohibited_bullet4: Posting misleading information about food, ingredients, or preparation.
tos_prohibited_warning: Violations may result in immediate account suspension.
tos_prohibited_summary: No selling, no payments, no commercial activity, no misleading information.

tos_intro: Welcome to Odlua! These Terms of Service govern your use of our food sharing platform. By accessing or using Odlua, you agree to be bound by these terms.
tos_section1_content: By creating an account or using Odlua, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy.
tos_section2_content: Odlua is a platform that connects home cooks (Chefs) with food enthusiasts. We facilitate the listing, discovery, and sharing of homemade food items.
tos_section3_content: To use Odlua, you must create an account and provide accurate information. You are responsible for:
tos_section3_bullet1: Maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials
tos_section3_bullet2: All activities that occur under your account
tos_section3_bullet3: Notifying us immediately of any unauthorized use
tos_section3_bullet4: Keeping your account information up to date
tos_section4_content: If you share food on Odlua, you agree to:
tos_section4_bullet1: Comply with all local food safety regulations and health standards
tos_section4_bullet2: Provide accurate descriptions, ingredients, and allergen information
tos_section4_bullet3: Maintain proper food handling and storage practices
tos_section4_bullet4: Fulfill orders in a timely manner as agreed
tos_section5_content: As a user on Odlua, you agree to:
tos_section5_bullet1: Provide accurate delivery or pickup information
tos_section5_bullet2: Check ingredient lists for allergens before requesting
tos_section6_content: You may not use Odlua to:
tos_section6_bullet2: Share prohibited or unsafe food items
tos_section6_bullet3: Harass, threaten, or abuse other users
tos_section6_bullet4: Post false, misleading, or deceptive content
tos_section6_bullet5: Attempt to circumvent platform fees or payments
tos_section7_content: You retain ownership of content you post on Odlua (photos, descriptions, etc.). However, you grant Odlua a non-exclusive license to use, display, and distribute your content on the platform.
tos_section8_content: All food sharing on Odlua should follow our community guidelines. Chefs and users should communicate clearly about pickup times and dietary requirements.
tos_section9_content: Odlua serves as a platform connecting chefs and users. We are not responsible for the quality, safety, or legality of food items listed. Users participate at their own risk. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Odlua is not liable for any damages arising from your use of the platform.
tos_section10_content: Any disputes between users should first be resolved directly through our in-app messaging. If resolution is not possible, contact our support team. Odlua may mediate disputes but is not obligated to resolve them.
tos_section11_content: Odlua may suspend or terminate your account for violations of these terms, fraudulent activity, or at our discretion. You may delete your account at any time through the app settings.
tos_section12_content: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of Odlua after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms. We will notify you of significant changes.
tos_contact_content: For questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at support@odlua.com
seller_agreement_intro: This Chef Agreement outlines the terms and conditions for sharing food on Odlua. By registering as a chef, you agree to comply with all requirements stated herein.
seller_section1_content: To become a chef on Odlua, you must meet the following requirements:
seller_section1_bullet1: Be at least 18 years of age
seller_section1_bullet3: Comply with local food handling regulations
seller_section1_bullet4: Have a clean and sanitary food preparation area
seller_section2_content: As a chef, you are responsible for maintaining the highest food safety standards:
seller_section2_bullet1: Prepare food in a clean, sanitary environment
seller_section2_bullet2: Store ingredients and prepared food at proper temperatures
seller_section2_bullet4: Clearly label all allergens and ingredients
seller_section2_bullet5: Package food safely for transport or pickup
seller_section3_content: All food listings must include accurate and complete information:
seller_section3_bullet1: Clear, honest descriptions of the dish
seller_section3_bullet2: Accurate photos of the actual food (no stock images)
seller_section4_content: Regarding pricing and payments on Odlua:
seller_section4_bullet1: You set your own prices for dishes
seller_section4_bullet2: Odlua may charge a service fee on transactions
seller_section4_bullet3: Payments are processed according to our payout schedule
seller_section5_content: You must fulfill orders according to these standards:
seller_section5_bullet2: Prepare food fresh and on time
seller_section5_bullet3: Communicate any delays or issues immediately
seller_section5_bullet4: Ensure food is ready for pickup or delivery as scheduled
seller_section6_content: Maintain professional and respectful communication with buyers at all times. Respond to messages promptly and address any concerns or questions they may have about your dishes.
seller_section7_content: Buyers may leave reviews and ratings for your dishes and service. These are important for building trust. Do not attempt to manipulate reviews or retaliate against buyers for honest feedback.
seller_section8_content: Odlua may suspend or terminate your seller account for:
seller_section8_bullet4: Violation of these terms or applicable laws
seller_section9_content: You are solely responsible for the food you prepare and sell. You agree to indemnify Odlua against any claims arising from your food or conduct. We recommend obtaining appropriate liability insurance.
seller_section10_content: We may update this Seller Agreement periodically. Continued use of the seller features constitutes acceptance of updated terms. You will be notified of material changes.
seller_contact_content: For questions about this Seller Agreement, please contact us at support@odlua.com
prohibited_intro: This Prohibited Use Policy outlines activities and content that are not allowed on Odlua. Violation of this policy may result in account suspension or termination.
prohibited_section1_content: The following food items are prohibited from being listed on Odlua:
prohibited_section1_bullet5: Raw or undercooked high-risk items (raw meat, unpasteurized products)
prohibited_section1_bullet6: Food that violates local health regulations
prohibited_section2_content: Users are prohibited from engaging in the following conduct:
prohibited_section2_bullet2: Discrimination based on race, gender, religion, or other protected characteristics
prohibited_section2_bullet4: Sharing personal information of other users without consent
prohibited_section3_content: The following content is not allowed on Odlua:
prohibited_section3_bullet1: False or misleading information about food or sellers
prohibited_section4_bullet1: Create multiple accounts to circumvent restrictions
prohibited_section4_bullet3: Attempt to hack or exploit the platform
prohibited_section4_bullet4: Impersonate other users or Odlua staff
prohibited_section5_content: The following transaction-related activities are prohibited:
prohibited_section5_bullet1: Conducting transactions outside the Odlua platform to avoid fees
prohibited_section5_bullet2: Using fake or stolen payment methods
prohibited_section5_bullet3: Manipulating prices or creating fake orders
prohibited_section6_content: Violations of this policy may result in:
prohibited_section7_content: If you encounter any violations of this policy, please report them through the app or contact our support team. We take all reports seriously and will investigate promptly.
prohibited_contact_content: For questions about this Prohibited Use Policy, please contact us at support@odlua.com
